stories.title: 20-year-old with murder cases arrested for killing Nerul man during robbery
stories.summary: A 20-year-old man, who was out on bail in previous murder and robbery cases registered in Raigad district, has been arrested for allegedly killing a 61-year-old man during a robbery in Nerul on November 9. The accused allegedly attacked the victim with a sharp weapon after he resisted an attempt to snatch his bag containing cash and a mobile phone.

stories.title: Dawood’s home in Bhendi Bazaar set to be demolished
stories.summary: Haji Ismail Habib Musafirkhana, the dilapidated building in South Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, which was once the home of fugitive underworld don Dawood Ibrahim and his family, is set to be demolished by the BMC. The demolition, however, did not begin on its scheduled date of November 18, as confirmed by a senior police officer.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai police bust alleged Ponzi racket linked to Ayurvedic products
stories.summary: The Navi Mumbai police have arrested four persons for allegedly running a Ponzi scheme promising people a shortcut to earn lakhs of rupees through chain-marketing investment under the guise of selling Ayurvedic products. The Economic Offences Wing of the Navi Mumbai Police on Monday arrested Mahadev Kakade, 42, CMD of Arthvardhan Health and Wealth Pvt Ltd, along with three others: Pradeep Chavan, 48; Santosh Aarvel; and Omprakash Gupta, 40.

stories.title: 15% property tax rebate for housing societies managing waste efficiently
stories.summary: The BMC has announced a property tax incentive of up to 15% for residential housing societies that comply with prescribed waste management norms, including processing wet waste on their premises, managing dry waste and adopting water conservation measures. The incentives form part of a wider push by the BMC to enforce four-way waste segregation across Mumbai (wet, dry, sanitary and special care or environmentally harmful waste).

stories.title: Have permanent show for citizens, not temporary show for guests: Bombay High Court to BMC
stories.summary: “We just observe, when some guests were coming, see Ballard Estate now, how shining and polished it is. If you want to do it, you do it, including painting, cleaning the streets with water... “If the state govt and the BMC have a will to do, they can transform things in no time.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA crackdown: Licences of Miyan Kababs, Natural Ice Cream suspended
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of 12 food establishments, including nine prominent restaurants in South Mumbai such as Chetana, Cafe Ideal, Bayroute, Miyan Kababs and Natural Ice Cream, following inspections that allegedly found serious food safety and hygiene violations. 27 crore across Maharashtra, shut down the businesses of six food vendors at Pune's Manikbaug Khau Galli and arrested five people during a statewide crackdown.

stories.title: Dadar station to be renamed Chaityabhoomi, says CM Devendra Fadnavis
stories.summary: Dec 6 marks the death anniversary of Dr B R Ambedkar, observed as Mahaparinirvan Din, when thousands of his followers from across the country converge at his memorial, Chaityabhoomi, in Dadar to pay homage. The meeting to review preparations for the occasion was attended by DCMs Eknath Shinde & Sunetra Pawar.

stories.title: 19-year-old woman killed, man critically injured as vehicle hits motorcycle on old Mumbai-Pune highway
stories.summary: A 19-year-old woman was killed and a 21-year-old man critically injured after an unidentified vehicle rammed their motorcycle on the old Mumbai-Pune highway near Ajivali village in Panvel late on Tuesday night. The deceased, identified as Ojal Rakesh Singh, was a resident of Indiabulls in Panvel. The injured motorcyclist, Aryan Pramod Dube, lives at Shivani Heritage in Ajivali village.

stories.title: Ferrari dealer’s trade cert suspended for 30 days for ‘unregistered’ vehicle delivery in Mumbai
stories.summary: The department’s media note stated: “Navnit Motors, Bandra, handed over a vehicle to its owner on October 13, even though the vehicle had not been registered at the time. ”Officials said that under Central Motor Vehicle Rules, installation of the High Security Registration Plate (HSRP) and vehicle registration are mandatory before a vehicle can be delivered to a customer.

stories.title: BMC expands war on plastic flowing into Arabian Sea
stories.summary: The BMC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Netherlands-based nonprofit The Ocean Cleanup to expand its efforts to prevent plastic and other floating waste from entering the Arabian Sea. Nine locations across Mumbai were identified for the deployment of interceptors that will trap the waste, in addition to the two existing ones at the Trombay and Malad creeks.

stories.title: Pedestrian First Campaign: BMC Demolishes 27 Structures in Kandivali West to End 15-Year Road-Widening Delay
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has demolished 27 commercial structures at the Mathuradas Road–Swami Vivekanand Road (SV Road) junction in Kandivali West, clearing a major hurdle in a road-widening project that had remained stalled for nearly 15 years.

stories.title: Kate Middleton debuts late Queen Elizabeth's sparkling emerald-diamond necklace for Earthshot Prize with Prince William in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, Prince William and Kate Middleton, attended the sixth annual Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai. The royal couple is in India to attend the Earthshot Prize events and meet young environmental innovators from across the world. For the awards ceremony in Mumbai, Prince William traded the tuxedo for a black Manish Malhotra bandhgala.

stories.title: Mumbai: Public toilets leave commuters struggling for basic hygiene
stories.summary: How clean are our public lavatories? On World Toilet Day, they fail the test conducted by mid-day. We discover why Mumbaikars, especially women, prefer relatively costlier but spotless Metro washrooms over filthy facilities along highways, at railway stations. For many Mumbaikars, answering nature’s call in a public toilet has become an exercise in compromise.

stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.title: Amid drought fund cuts, govt to spend ₹20 crore on disaster management booklets
stories.summary: In order to teach schoolchildren about natural and manmade disasters, safety measures and emergency responses, the Maharashtra government is set to distribute disaster management booklets to Class 7 and Class 8 students across the state. The move has raised eyebrows in Mantralaya, where all-round expenditure is being curtailed in order to divert funds for drought-mitigation work.

stories.title: Salman Khan surprises Maatrubhumi cast and crew with luxury watches worth up to ₹6 lakh at Panvel farmhouse
stories.summary: Salman Khan recently gave the cast and crew of his upcoming film Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace a reason to remember their time on the project. The actor hosted a get-together at his Panvel farmhouse on November 12, where he surprised the team with luxury Swiss watches.

stories.title: Mumbai’s First Underground Toilet-Cum-Art Gallery Planned at Kala Ghoda; BMC Approves ₹24-Crore Project
stories.summary: In a move to improve pedestrian movement and preserve the heritage character of South Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has given in-principle approval to develop an underground public facility near Lion Gate in Kala Ghoda. Estimated to cost ₹24 crore, the proposed project will replace the existing Aspirational Toilet and Solid Waste Management (SWM) department chowkies with a 1,668-square-metre underground complex.

stories.title: Duo promising Navi Mumbai airport jobs for cash arrested
stories.summary: 63 lakh fraud, with a Nalasopara woman and her relatives claiming they were cheated by two men who promised them private-sector employment but failed to provide jobs despite collecting money. The 27-year-old woman approached Vakola police station after repeatedly failing to get a response from the accused — Sudhakar Fatarpekar and his nephew Sai Sanjay Fatarpekar.

stories.title: Mumbai Diary: Thursday Dossier
stories.summary: Eyes on the ball Five-year-old Neeraj Jadhav locks his gaze on a delivery during net practice at Shivaji Park . Onward goes Yuri Yuri and The City; (right) Jerry Pinto The books… they just keep on coming, this season. Mumbai’s own Jerry Pinto follows the recent furore of book launches with his latest title, Yuri and The City (Speaking Tiger).

stories.title: SC junks plea challenging quashing of FIRs against former Mumbai CP Sanjay Pandey
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Tuesday dismissed a special leave petition (SLP) filed by businessman Sanjay Punamiya challenging the Bombay High Court’s decision to quash two FIRs registered in 2024 against former Mumbai police commissioner Sanjay Pandey and others over allegations of fabricating a government appointment letter, extortion, intimidation, coercion and threatening criminal prosecution.

stories.title: 200 Shahunagar residents storm out of Dharavi redevelopment meet
stories.summary: Around 200 residents of Mahim’s Shahunagar staged a walkout from an awareness-cum-assistance camp on the impending Dharavi redevelopment project, on Wednesday. They alleged that Adani Navbharat Developers Private Limited (ANDPL), which organised the camp and is also executing the mega-redevelopment project, is unwilling to share vital information on their redevelopment, on their new homes, and how the 13 acres of land that houses their colony will be utilised.

stories.title: Shinde Sena meet to condemn Sonia’s “insult” of Savarkar ends with Shaina NC tearing Bal Thackeray photo
stories.summary: A meeting called on Wednesday by the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena to protest against Sonia Gandhi’s “insult” of Hindutva idealogue V D Savarkar in her autobiography saw a bizarre and comedic twist when Sena spokesperson Shaina N C allegedly tore a picture of Bal Thackeray and found herself at the receiving end of protests by the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena (UBT).

stories.title: Diversion of funds robs 9.1 mn farmers of cash aid for a year under flagship scheme
stories.summary: 13 million farmers across Maharashtra enrolled under the Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Yojana (NSMY), one of the many populist schemes launched by the Eknath Shinde-led Mahayuti government ahead of the 2024 assembly polls, have not received cash payouts for the past one year as funds have been diverted towards other expenses.

stories.title: Cafe Ideal, Chetana, Miyan Kababs face FDA action
stories.summary: The Food and Drugs Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of nine restaurants in Mumbai, including Cafe Ideal at Radio Club, Chetana at Kala Ghoda, Bayroute at Cuffe Parade, Miyan Kababs at Fort, and Natural Ice Creams at Churchgate. Other establishments like Gupta Fruit Juice Centre (Nariman Point), Prakash Dosa (Fort) and Saurabh Hotels (Colaba) also faced action due to unhygienic kitchen and food preparation practices and improper storage of food.

stories.title: Builder gets second pollution notice in two months at Powai site
stories.summary: A builder at a redevelopment site in Powai has been served a second show cause notice in two months, this time for alleged violation of air pollution mitigation guidelines. The earlier notice, served after numerous complaints from residents of Hiranandani Gardens, concerned noise pollution exceeding permissible decibel levels.

stories.title: BMC starts axing 184 trees at Versova’s Nana Nani Park for Coastal Road
stories.summary: Chainsaws got to work at Versova’s beloved Nana Nani Park on Wednesday morning, hacking trees to make way for the Versova-Bhayandar Coastal Road project. Local residents had fought a gritty but losing battle to spare the park, a community hub and a green lung in their neighbourhood. The coastal road will cost the park a large part of its tree cover so that an interchange can be built for the infrastructure project.

stories.title: Charity Commissioner orders inquiry into allegations against Lilavati Trust
stories.summary: The Charity Commissioner’s office has taken suo motu cognizance of allegations of financial irregularities and mismanagement in Lilavati Kiritlal Mehta Medical Trust (LKMMT), which runs the Lilavati Hospital and Research Centre in Bandra, and ordered an independent inquiry into the affairs of the trust. 58 crore through charitable foundations and private entities.

stories.title: Mumbai building once home to Daw­o­od Ibrahim to be demolished
stories.summary: BMC plans to commence the demolition of Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana, which housed Dawood Ibrahim's family. This building was constructed in 1939 and later classified as dilapidated. The demolition was authorized following a Bombay High Court order in August 2020. Most occupants have vacated the building in anticipation of the demolition, leaving only a prayer hall.

stories.title: Mumbai home tour: Swara adapt bungalow for family life
stories.summary: Swara Bhasker and Fahad Ahmad gave a tour of their old-world rented bungalow in Chembur, filled with vintage furniture, art and colourful wallpapers. Calling it “a sanctuary,” Swara highlighted gifted artworks and daughter Rabia’s bright playroom, stocked with books and body-positive dolls. The couple married in January 2023.

stories.title: BMC signs MoU with Dutch non-profit to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai rivers
stories.summary: In a move to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai's waterways, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Netherlands-based non-profit organisation The Ocean Cleanup to expand waste interception operations across the city. The agreement signed between The Ocean Cleanup and the BMC will also facilitate nine additional permits for deploying the organisation's Interceptor systems in Mumbai's waterways.

stories.title: Mumbai: Prince William takes electric rickshaw for a spin at Bandra reclamation
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Catherine, drove an electric autorickshaw on the promenade at Bandra Reclamation Garden on Tuesday morning. The appearance was to meet the finalists of the Earthshot Prize at the waterfront. Tuesday marked the second day of their ongoing three-day visit to Mumbai.

stories.title: Delhi court orders framing of charges against 14 accused in NEET-UG paper leak case
stories.summary: A Delhi fast-track court on Wednesday ordered the framing of charges against 14 people accused in the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak case. The CBI alleged that three National Testing Agency (NTA)-contracted subject experts stole confidential examination questions and passed them on to a network of middlemen and coaching operators for monetary gain.

stories.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here. “Grand Theft Auto VI” launches Thursday, sending players back to Vice City and testing whether Rockstar Games can follow one of the bestselling video games ever made with another cultural and commercial phenomenon.

stories.summary: The projected trajectory of the Severe Cyclonic Storm (SCS) Akvan kept changing its path on Wednesday. And, due to the uncertainty over the movement of the system, the northern parts of Andhra Pradesh and southern parts of Odisha have now been placed on alert.

stories.title: Flood-hit Florida braces for more rain as roads go underwater, schools shut
stories.summary: Parts of the northern Miami metropolitan area, particularly Broward County, have recorded the heaviest rainfall. More than a foot of rain, equivalent to over three Novembers' worth of precipitation, fell in the Hollywood area within a few hours, the National Weather Service in Miami said. Hollywood's mayor declared a state of emergency and urged residents to shelter in place as flooding forced the closure of sections of Interstate 95 and Florida's Turnpike.

stories.title: Gurdaspur man turns paddy stubble into fire-proof ceiling tiles after 8 years
stories.summary: Every harvest season, the fields of Punjab face a familiar problem. Once the paddy is cut, farmers are left with heaps of dry straw that must be cleared before the next crop can be planted. With limited time and costly alternatives, many resort to burning the residue, adding to the region’s air pollution.

stories.summary: A Delhi court on Wednesday told the Delhi Police to file an action taken report (ATR) on a private complaint filed by a lawyer claiming that senior Congress leader Sonia Gandhi was enrolled in the electoral rolls in 1980 before she acquired Indian citizenship.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan walks out of jail, Akhilesh Yadav says ‘truth has triumphed’
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Azam Khan walked out of Ghaziabad's Dasna jail on Wednesday evening after he was granted interim bail in a money laundering case, days after he was held by the Enforcement Directorate and remanded to judicial custody by a court. Party president Akhilesh Yadav described Khan's release as a victory of truth, expressing confidence that the former state minister would continue to get justice.

stories.title: In her first all-hands meeting, Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress promises salary hikes to 49,000 employee
stories.summary: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress used the opening minutes of her first all-hands meeting to talk about money. She spoke to staff on Wednesday, a week after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. Kress told employees to expect pay raises and more equity in December, months ahead of the usual schedule, according to remarks reviewed by Wired.

stories.title: Amitabh Bachchan Seemingly Reveals Why He Posted 'Bach Gaye' Amid Bomb Threats
stories.summary: Amitabh Bachchan has finally explained the context behind his cryptic ‘Bach Gaye’ post on X, which had sparked speculation amid reports of an alleged threat to his security. Soon after the arrests came to light, Bachchan had shared a brief post on X that read, ‘Bach Gaye’. However, the actor has now clarified what prompted the tweet.

stories.title: Sena (UBT) targets Shah over Ajit Pawar tribute, defends Uddhav's Covid record
stories.summary: The Shiv Sena (Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray) on Wednesday accused Union Home Minister Amit Shah of "hypocrisy" and "political opportunism" over his tribute to late Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar, while questioning the handling of the investigation into the plane crash that killed the NCP leader.

stories.title: Abhishek made tea on sets when Amitabh Bachchan faced bankruptcy
stories.summary: Amitabh Bachchan may be one of the most successful superstars in the Indian film industry today, but his journey has not been without financial setbacks. One of the most difficult phases of his life came in the late 1990s, when his entertainment venture, Amitabh Bachchan Corporation Limited (ABCL), ran into severe financial trouble and reportedly left him with debts of Rs 90 crore.

stories.title: Pak Minister Set For India Visit Had Made "Cut Hands" Threat Over Indus Waters Treaty
stories.summary: At a water conference earlier this year, Pakistan's Climate Minister Musadik Malik warned against "water aggression", urging India to respect the 1960 treaty that Delhi put in abeyance following the 2025 Pahalgam terror attack in Kashmir.

stories.title: Government inks deal with Israel to upgrade Barak missile system
stories.summary: 40-crore contract with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) to upgrade and manage the obsolescence of the Barak Point Defence Missile System deployed aboard Indian Navy warships. The contract was signed in New Delhi in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure. The upgrade is aimed at enhancing the operational capabilities of the Barak missile systems and strengthening the air defence capabilities of Indian Navy platforms.

stories.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
stories.summary: A Pakistani man with ties to Iran's government has been sentenced to 27 years in prison for his role in a plot to assassinate US President Donald Trump and other officials.

stories.title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be US Speaker of the House
stories.summary: Democrats in the US House of Representatives officially nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker, setting him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber. The House will elect its new Speaker on 3 January, when the next term begins and Democrats will hold a majority of the seats.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says
stories.summary: The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, a Russian official has said. The Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, confirmed that traffic was temporarily suspended following another strike on the bridge connecting mainland Russia to occupied Crimea. The critical bridge had already been hit twice earlier in the week resulting in severe damage and part of the bridge collapsing into the water.

stories.title: Kerch attack: Bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea has been hit again
stories.summary: Ukraine has critically damaged the Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia in an overnight missile attack, in what Volodymyr Zelenskyy hailed as an “unprecedented” military operation. Footage showed a Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile seconds before it hit the road and railway crossing, followed by an explosion. The strike follows an earlier attack on Monday that targeted an arch across its central section.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge traffic halted after third Ukrainian attack in a week, Russian official says | World News
stories.summary: Traffic was temporarily suspended over the Crimean Bridge after an attack, Sergei Aksyonov, Crimea's Russian-installed governor, said on Telegram on Thursday, adding that assessment of the damage was underway. The attack is the third this week on the bridge that connects mainland Russia with Crimea, which Russia annexed from Ukraine in 2014, in a blow to President Vladimir Putin ahead of his meetings with US and Chinese counterparts on Thursday.

stories.title: World Court To Rule Today On Myanmar's Alleged Rohingya Genocide
stories.summary: When the judges of the International Court of Justice read out their verdict in the seven-year-old genocide case filed by The Gambia against Myanmar on Thursday, they could make history. In the years since the Genocide Convention was signed in 1948, after the Nazi Holocaust, dozens of individuals have been successfully prosecuted for the crime of genocide, in conflicts such as those in Rwanda and the former Yugoslavia.

stories.summary: Elon Musk said on Wednesday that he felt "pretty foolish" about the record sum he spent on the US midterm elections, following sweeping Republican defeats. The Tesla and SpaceX CEO was the campaign's top individual donor, giving $446m (£339m) to support President Donald Trump's party, particularly in Texas where many of Musk's firms are based.

stories.title: Litton Das scripts history, Bangladesh keeper sets world record in South Africa Test
stories.summary: Bangladesh wicketkeeper Litton Das created a new world record for the most dismissals by a wicketkeeper in a single Test innings, taking his tally to eight against South Africa in the ongoing first Test at the Wanderers in Johannesburg. Wasim Bari, Bob Taylor, Ian Smith, Ridley Jacobs and Joshua Da Silva had all recorded seven dismissals in a Test innings.

stories.title: US plans tougher rules for companies sponsoring foreign workers for Green Cards | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: The US Department of Labor has proposed sweeping changes to the employment-based Green Card process, including a two-year restriction on employers sponsoring foreign workers for permanent residency after laying off American workers in similar roles. The proposal, announced on November 16, seeks to overhaul the Permanent Labor Certification programme, commonly known as PERM.

stories.title: Ukraine war briefing: US criticism of Kyiv’s deep strikes in Russia is ‘quite stupid’, says Germany
stories.summary: The Pentagon has warned Ukraine’s western backers that strikes deep inside Russia are counterproductive and urged them to focus their military support on equipment for frontline combat. Germany immediately dismissed the warning as “stupid,” while Britain said the strikes are saving lives. The disagreement came as Ukraine’s supporters met at Nato headquarters on Tuesday to rally support for more arms and ammunition.

stories.title: Hegseth unveils new US-Venezuela military deal
stories.summary: Pete Hegseth has unveiled a new military deal with Venezuela in his first visit since the January US military raid to capture President Nicolas Maduro. The visit comes amid growing unease in Venezuela about the US’s influence over the country’s sovereignty.

stories.summary: A new study by the Pew Research Center, projecting the world's religious populations to 2070, estimates that Hindus will make up 76% of India's population by then, down from 79% in 2020, while the Muslim share will rise from 15% to 20%. The shift is rooted largely in differences in age and fertility: Indian Muslims are younger than Hindus and, on average, have more children.
